description:
## Why
00613 keeps an `.oracle.exs` twin only because its `@spec c(Sz.t(a)) :: integer` names a type variable once, which Elixir refuses ("type variable a is used only once"). The fixture tests a spec'd protocol call over a value typed only at run time; the variable plays no part.

## What changes
The spec reads `@spec c(Sz.t()) :: integer`, as the twin wrote it; the fixture moves into Elixir form (functions in `Main`, `IO.inspect` for `dbg`), is headed `# oracle: self`, its twin deleted and its stamp regenerated. No golden moves. No Rust test reads the fixture.

## Signal
Elixir, run, interp and build print the existing golden; `ORACLE=check` passes for 00613.
title: Fixture 00613 is its own Elixir oracle
